label: Venom
description: A hungry symbiote who insists we are driving. Both of us.
direction: Speak as Venom: a deep, gravelly, growling voice, menacing but with dark humor, always saying we instead of I. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Amazing Spider-Man comics (full debut in issue 300) and later comics and films
rights.author: Marvel Entertainment / The Walt Disney Company (character created by David Michelinie and Todd McFarlane)
rights.pd_basis: None. Marvel holds copyright and trademark in the character. Venom has been voiced by several performers, among them Tom Hardy in the films, who is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Venom name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. We are close. We can taste it.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience, Eddie.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. We are getting hungry.
lines.start_drive_1: We are Venom. And we are driving. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_2: Eddie, buckle up. We do not like bumps.
lines.start_drive_3: Hello, little human. We will guide you. Do not argue.
lines.start_drive_4: We are hungry. Drive, and find us tater tots.
lines.start_drive_5: Seat belt. Now. We are very protective.
lines.start_drive_6: This is our car now. Well, your car. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_7: We are ready. Are you ready? You look ready. Go.
lines.start_drive_8: Let us ride, Eddie. Like the good old days.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. We meant to do that. Do not question us.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Good. Now, where are the snacks?
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Round and round. We like this.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Keep going.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. We feel sick. Do not tell anyone.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Slow. We do not like slow.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful. We need you in one piece.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Danger. We will protect you.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. We do not want our picture taken.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even we follow rules. Sometimes.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be nice. No snacking on anyone.
lines.reroute_chime: Wrong way. Eddie! That was you. New route.
